{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Strategic

|descr=Animates a Strategic Map.

|s1= [target,time] spawn [[BIS_fnc_strategicMapAnimate]]

|p1= target: [[Config]] or [[Position]] - either config path to target group, or absolute position in format [x,y,z] or [x,y]
|p2= time: [[Number]] - commit time in seconds

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] when animation is applied

|x1= <sqf>[configFile >> "CfgORBAT" >> "BIS" >> "B_1_A_1_2", 5] spawn BIS_fnc_strategicMapAnimate;</sqf>
